foundation.name: OverviewReadSnapshotFactory
foundation.contract: one SQLite read transaction/snapshot shared across all LLD-11 provider calls; no write upgrade or commit path

providers.name: CustomerScopeProvider
providers.rule: specific scope resolves immutable Customer Organization identity; unassigned is explicit rather than null-as-all

providers.name: TicketOverviewProjectionProvider
providers.rule: target stream includes distinct accepted SR/RFC identities in the same customer/window scope; lifecycle/source facts remain LLD-03 authority

providers.name: ObjectiveOverviewProjectionProvider
providers.rule: target stream includes distinct accepted WFM/Objective identities in scope; Objective context derives through Tasks and source plan never substitutes execution

providers.name: SlaOverviewProjectionProvider
providers.rule: SLA/cohort/classification truth remains LLD-06 and unknown/unclassified is explicit

providers.name: InventoryOverviewProjectionProvider
providers.rule: target stream includes distinct accepted Spare Request/RMA/Fault Tag identities in scope; mixed physical/logistics lifecycle remains LLD-07 authority

providers.name: InfrastructureOverviewProjectionProvider
providers.rule: Infrastructure contributes registration/placement/regularization attention only and is not a Communication target family in Beta 1.0

providers.name: CommunicationSummaryProvider
providers.rule: exact sealed LLD-09 provider; LLD-11 never reads Communication tables/body directly

composition_interfaces.name: CommunicationOverviewAssembler
composition_interfaces.rule: deduplicate exact target refs, call entity_summary on the same snapshot, sum received/sent/unknown and pending-proposal counts once per distinct linked entity, select latest independently supported interaction chronology, combine coverage/freshness without coercing unknown to complete, and emit no body content

provider_rules: every provider receives the caller's read snapshot and never opens a second authority connection
owner projections return accepted-state aggregates plus typed attention/timeline/activity facts and ProviderMetadataV1; no mutable dashboard record exists
communication target iterators are deterministic/distinct and belong to the same Customer/window scope as their owner projection
typed coverage unknown/partial/unconfigured is successful explicit data; unexpected provider failure is not converted to zero
no provider exposes Resolved Status Date or reconstructable communication bodies to Overview
LLD-01..08 provider-side adapter declarations are regression/V2-retrofit obligations; these consumer signatures are the canonical contract they must satisfy before peer review
